overall_rationale: The three must needs are each met with conditions. N1 (hourly pollutants) has the UCI prototype file (conditional on -200 cleaning, licence-conflict decision and single-site scope) and the EMU station readings for production (conditional on access and station-list confirmation). N2 (traffic) rests on the Mobility Office counts for production, conditional on access, the 2024-03-18 counter-change break and a counter-to-station mapping. N3 (temperature and humidity) rests on Open-Meteo for both windows, conditional on a Legal decision because the free tier is non-commercial. The Bologna traffic, Chicago, Eurostat and vendor sources are not feasible. N5 (patient records) has no usable source and is barred by policy. N6 (national deaths) is not feasible on coverage. Both are could-priority needs, so the overall verdict is not driven by them.

need_coverage.gap: Prototype relies on a single road-level device with sparse reference values and no PM2.5; production depends on EMU access and an unconfirmed station list (VR-03).
Counts straddle the 2024-03-18 counting change and there is no counter-to-station mapping; Bologna counts cannot substitute for Valdena traffic.
Open-Meteo is a 10 km modelled grid, its free-tier use is non-commercial, and full-window coverage at both ends is not yet probed; the vendor feed is not usable.
Access, purpose confirmation and a district-to-station join key are required; case definition and zero-day convention are undocumented.
No candidate source; clinic policy only allows daily district counts, so patient-level records are not available for this purpose.
Eurostat series ends 2023 (production 0% covered, prototype about 24%) and its licence is unknown.
